new_value: Rust range-testing wire codecs shipped in lichen-client: rangetest module (RadioMetrics/RangeTestReading/TracerouteResult/RangeTestRequest types; ciborium decode of SenML packs with RFC 8428 numeric labels; request-body encode with spec-18.7 bounds enforced client-side).
